newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Zoran EPS estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Zoran EPS estimate raised.

text.p: Salomon Brothers has raised its 1997 earnings per share (EPS) estimate for Zoran to $0.72 per share against a former forecast of $0.70 and is maintaining its hold rating, Salomon said in a report.
The 1998 EPS estimate of $1.20 has remained unchanged.
While increasing the EPS estimates, Salomon is decreasing its projected revenue from $62 million to $60.2 million.

"First quarter EPS amounted to $0.06, up from our $0.05 estimate and flat with the same period last year on 8.5 percent more shares outstanding. Zoran beat street estimate of $0.04 EPS, as company's performance was saved by strong software licensing revenues late in the quarter," the report said.

Salomon said Zoran's future prosperity continues to be dependent on the success of the Digital Video Disc (DVD) technology. Introduction of the DVD-Rom players in the United States remains delayed because of licencing disputes regarding copyrights.

"One of the major keys for Zoran's operational success lies in the copyrights resolution, which may happen in the third quarter of 1997. Resolution of the copyrights issue should be viewed by the market as catalyst for the stock appreciation," the report said.
